tips.text: BRD is huge: decide the route (prison, Ring of Law, Lyceum, Emperor) before you enter and avoid patrolling golems.
Fire resistance helps for Lord Incendius and the Lyceum; drink during the Ring of Law arena reset.
Grab Commander Gor'shak and the Ring of Law early; the Kharan Mighthammer and Princess Moira chain is the big XP step.
Run Blackrock Depths once. Do not reset for more dark iron.
At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour. Kill XP inside dungeons is increased by 50%. If any party member would get no XP because the mobs are trivial to them, nobody in the party gets XP.
